# bumbleflies

> Facilitation, AI Consulting, and App Development for organizations navigating change. Based in Munich, serving the DACH region. Three founders, four service pillars, one goal: helping teams talk, decide, and build.

We help teams move from conversation to code. Our approach combines structured facilitation with hands-on technical execution: no consulting decks that collect dust, just work that sticks.

## Services

- [Talk: Facilitation & Workshop Design](https://bumbleflies.de/services): Structured dialogue that surfaces real issues and creates clarity. bumble:space (Open Space), team alignment, sensitive topics.
- [Decide: Decision-Making & Strategy](https://bumbleflies.de/services): From strategic direction to operational ownership. Decisions that stick because the right people made them.
- [Build & Embed: Software Development](https://bumbleflies.de/services): Custom software, internal tools, and AI applications built to solve real organizational problems. Not handoffs: partnerships.
- [Full Journey: End-to-End Engagement](https://bumbleflies.de/services): From first conversation through implementation. When the problem doesn't fit a single box.

- [AI Consulting](https://bumbleflies.de/ai-consulting): Practical AI for organizations, no hype, just results. From strategy to implementation.

## How We Work

- [Our Approach](https://bumbleflies.de/how-we-work): How facilitation and development connect. The bumbleflies method.
- [Why bumbleflies](https://bumbleflies.de/why-bumbleflies): Why teams choose us and keep coming back.
- [Why We Exist](https://bumbleflies.de/why-we): The integrated model: why one team doing Talk + Decide + Build beats fragmented vendors.
- [Risk Derisking](https://bumbleflies.de/risk-derisking): How we reduce risk in organizational change.
- [Open Space Moderation](https://bumbleflies.de/open-space): Open Space conferences for 8-500 people. We sharpen the question with you, facilitate the marketplace, and document decisions with named owners. Formats, references and process.

## Case Studies

- [Siemens AG: Enterprise Team Alignment](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/siemens): Full-day workshop with a large enterprise team. Clear decisions, named owners, immediate follow-up bookings.
- [LeagueSphere: Building a Regional SaaS](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/leaguesphere): From spreadsheet chaos to live product across 6+ German leagues. 5-year partnership, recurring SaaS revenue.
- [Dialograum Geld: Values-Driven Community Dialogue](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/dialograum-geld): Open Space facilitation for sensitive money conversations. Taboo lifted, community voices heard.
- [Wohnungshelden: Annual Team Alignment](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/wohnungshelden): Annual Open Space retrospective that teams actually look forward to. Ritual, not obligation.
- [UnternehmerTUM: Agile Transformation at Scale](https://bumbleflies.de/case-studies/unternehmertum): Multi-cohort training and coaching. Blended Talk+Decide model for sustained organizational change.

## Blog

- [Statt KI zu kaufen: Was ich wirklich gebaut habe](https://bumbleflies.de/blog/ki-agenten-betriebssystem): Field Notes #1. A real agent system in production: autonomous agents opening pull requests, a skill marketplace for company knowledge, a cockpit planning the day. With audio summary.
- [Skills als Apps: ein Plugin-Marktplatz für Firmenwissen](https://bumbleflies.de/blog/skills-als-apps-plugin-marktplatz): Field Notes #4. Company knowledge as an internal app store: the marketplace is the store, each plugin an app, each skill a feature. The rule that holds it together is model judgment plus deterministic script, so humans, agents and CI run the same code. With audio summary.
- [What I Actually Built Instead of "Adding AI" (EN)](https://bumbleflies.de/en/blog/ai-agent-operating-system): English version of Field Notes #1. With audio summary.
- [Die Fundamente, auf denen alles läuft: Zustand und Interaktion](https://bumbleflies.de/blog/zwei-ebenen-zustand-und-interaktion): Field Notes #2. How a production agent system coordinates entirely through two existing SaaS tools, a project management tool as persistent state, a team chat as the interaction layer, instead of custom microservices. With audio summary.
- [The Foundations Everything Runs On: State and Interaction (EN)](https://bumbleflies.de/en/blog/two-levels-state-interaction): English version of Field Notes #2. With audio summary.
- [Zwischenspiel: Von der Anforderung bis live an einem Export](https://bumbleflies.de/blog/anforderung-bis-live): Field Notes #2.5. One concrete requirement-to-live trace answering the "too abstract" feedback: a missing export column travels from support chat through ticket, enrichment, testing, and batch rollout to regression and docs.
- [Interlude: From request to live, traced through one export (EN)](https://bumbleflies.de/en/blog/requirement-to-live): English version of Field Notes #2.5.
- [Das Nervensystem: Event-Automatisierung und wie man ein Sprachmodell ehrlich hält](https://bumbleflies.de/blog/nervensystem-n8n-automatisierung): Field Notes #3. How an always-on n8n automation pillar turns support emails into classified tickets with a self-learning router trained on human corrections, plus a multi-stage privacy filter that shows what "don't trust the model, verify with code" looks like in practice. With audio summary.
- [The Nervous System: Event Automation and How to Keep a Language Model Honest (EN)](https://bumbleflies.de/en/blog/nervous-system-event-automation): English version of Field Notes #3. With audio summary.

## Agent Skills

Free, standalone skills for assistants that support the SKILL.md format (Claude Code, Claude skills, compatible agents). They help an employee or a management team work out whether a problem exists and what would actually solve it. They are useful on their own, including when the answer is that bumbleflies is not the right provider. Category: Discover.

- [Business Problem Discovery](https://bumbleflies.de/skills/business-problem-discovery/SKILL.md): Structured discovery of processes that cost time, money or quality. Business model, repetitive work, bottlenecks, knowledge silos, then a qualified opportunity assessment.
- [AI Opportunity Finder](https://bumbleflies.de/skills/ai-opportunity-finder/SKILL.md): Decides per process between AI, deterministic automation, agentic workflow or a process fix. Input shape and error cost decide, not ambition.
- [Agentic Transformation Readiness](https://bumbleflies.de/skills/agentic-transformation-readiness/SKILL.md): Scores process stability, state and tool access, review capacity, failure tolerance, data rules and ownership. Names the first agent-shaped slice and its guardrails.
- [Build vs. Buy Advisor](https://bumbleflies.de/skills/build-vs-buy-advisor/SKILL.md): Structures build, buy, integrate or extend using what is already paid for, time to value, lock-in and maintenance, and states what would flip the recommendation.
- [AI Business Case Calculator](https://bumbleflies.de/skills/ai-business-case/SKILL.md): One-page case from real numbers: costs including review labour, benefit, risks, payback and a sensitivity run. Includes the honest do-not-do-it.
- [AI Project Scoping](https://bumbleflies.de/skills/ai-project-scoping/SKILL.md): Turns a validated opportunity into goal, non-goals, first slice, milestones, roles, data needs, evaluation and an effort range with assumptions.
